name: phi_per_OD
note: Total E. coli volume per unit OD600.
source_note: Measured directly across 22 growth conditions: 1 mL at OD600 = 1 holds about 3.6 uL of cells, with 2.4 to 4.5 uL across individual conditions. This project previously carried 8e-4, a textbook estimate of 8e8 cells per mL at 1 um3 each, which is 4.5x low because growing cells are larger than that. The model treats the whole cell volume as the cytoplasmic compartment, so it overstates the cytoplasm by the periplasmic fraction.

name: peri_frac
note: Periplasm as a fraction of cell volume.
source_note: No source is recorded for it in this project; it is the standard fraction.

name: k_mem
note: Cytoplasm-medium H2O2 exchange, P*(S/V).
source_note: The membrane permeability coefficient of 1.6e-3 cm/s reported in this work, times a surface-to-volume ratio of about 6 per um for an E. coli cell.

name: k_scav
note: Intracellular H2O2 scavenging by KatG/KatE/AhpCF in the wild type.
source_note: Not measured directly. Forced by two measurements in this work: a production rate of 14 uM/s against a resting cytoplasmic level of about 0.02 uM gives 700 /s.

name: k_scav_knockout
note: Residual scavenging in a catalase/peroxidase triple knockout (Hpx-). Used only to test whether a type-A candidate needs the knockout to pass.
source_note: Chosen so a catalase/peroxidase triple knockout rests near 2.8 uM. Used only to test whether a candidate would need the knockout, never as a measurement.

name: P_endo
note: Endogenous cytoplasmic H2O2 production in a growing culture.
source_note: Measured directly in aerobically growing cells.

name: k_chem
note: Chemical H2O2 loss in the medium. Zero unless the sample matrix contributes.
source_note: Set to zero. A sample matrix that destroys peroxide would make this positive, and none of the studies reports it.

name: K_oxyr
note: Cytoplasmic H2O2 at half OxyR activation.
source_note: In vitro titration: 0.1 uM oxidised half the purified protein within 30 s, and 0.05 to 0.2 uM did so across conditions. The same work needed 5 uM outside the cell for the same effect in vivo, which this model carries separately as k_scav rather than folding it into K.

name: n_hill
note: Hill coefficient of OxyR activation.
source_note: Non-cooperative. OxyR is a dimer of dimers and could be cooperative; no source in this project measures it.

name: beta
note: Promoter output at full OxyR activation.
source_note: Sets the signal scale, not the fold between two samples, which is what every verdict uses.

name: leak
note: Basal promoter output.
source_note: Sets the blank, not the fold between two samples.

name: gfp_maturation_halflife_s
note: Wild-type GFP maturation half-life. k_mat = ln2 / this.
source_note: Measured in living E. coli by time-lapse, and it is the reporter the wet lab actually has: wild-type GFP, t50 = 36.1 +/- 2.1 min at 37 C, Table 1. Confirmed against the plasmid sequence rather than taken on report - the avGFP chromophore is intact and every fast-variant marker is wild type. This project previously carried 816 s, which is the sfGFP row of the same table and the wrong reporter. Other variants there, for a branch scan: GFPmut3 4.1, GFPmut2 5.6, sfGFP 13.6, mEGFP 14.5 min.

name: growth_doubling_pre_s
note: Doubling time before the assay. mu_pre = ln2 / this.
source_note: An operating condition of the assay, not a property of anything.

name: growth_doubling_s
note: Doubling time during the assay. mu = ln2 / this.
source_note: An operating condition of the assay, not a property of anything.

name: cv_reader
note: Relative SD of a single fluorescence measurement.
source_note: The reader this screen assumes. It sets the limit of detection, so the sensitivity analysis varies it.

name: n_rep
note: Technical replicates.

name: creatinine_MW_g_per_mol
note: Molar mass of creatinine. Converts creatinine g/L to mol/L for the per-mol-creatinine units.

name: hill_n_binding
note: Hill coefficient assumed for module types B and C. Modelling assumption, not a measured constant: 1.0 means non-cooperative single-site binding. No source reports a Hill coefficient for any sensor in sensors.csv.
source_note: No source reports a Hill coefficient for any sensor in sensors.csv.

name: z_required
note: Z needed to call two fluorescence readings separable at the reader.

name: auc_pass_min
note: Reported AUC at or above which stage 1 passes on the AUC route.

name: p_pass_max
note: Two-sided Welch p below which stage 1 can pass on the statistics route.

name: cohens_d_pass_min
note: Absolute Cohen's d required alongside the p-value. Both are needed, so a tiny effect at huge n does not pass.

name: sd_over_value_max
note: Applies only to an SD reconstructed from a range or an IQR. If that SD exceeds the central value by more than this, the strictly positive quantity cannot be anywhere near normal, the reconstruction is not trustworthy, and the row is called insufficient rather than failed. A spread the authors reported directly as an SD or SEM is never second-guessed this way.

name: conc_factor_max
note: Largest sample concentration factor considered achievable. Above this a candidate is red rather than yellow.

name: kd_ratio_lo
note: Analyte/Kd below this is called below-Kd: the sensor sits in its dead zone.

name: kd_ratio_hi
note: Analyte/Kd above this is called saturated.

name: conversion_target
note: Fraction of the analyte that must be turned over inside the read time. Sets the minimum enzyme loading reported by the enzyme comparison.

name: knockout_gain_min
note: Relative fold improvement a scavenger knockout must give before it is called helpful, rather than noise in the integration.

name: panel_rho_independent
note: Correlation assumed between markers from unrelated pathways. The optimistic bound on a panel: markers carry independent information.

name: panel_rho_correlated
note: Correlation assumed between markers of the same pathway, such as putrescine, spermidine and spermine, which share the polyamine biosynthetic route. The pessimistic bound. Neither value is measured: no source in clinical.csv reports a covariance between markers in the same patients, so panels are reported as a range between these two and never as a point estimate.

name: panel_max_size
note: Largest panel considered. Beyond this the combinatorics stop being informative given how few modules clear stage 2.
